latin: Quod in Phedro dicitur dorsum coeli, in Parmenide dicitur unum; quod ibi profundum coeli, hic totum; quod ibi axis coeli, hic terminus. u
translation: What is called the 'back of heaven' in the Phaedrus is called the 'one' in the Parmenides; what there is the 'depth of heaven' is here the 'whole'; what there is the 'axis of heaven' is here the 'limit'.
